title: Design: a tier's page, its tabs and its matrix list
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows with tier A's row.

Step 2:

  • The tier's number shows in small plain text before its name, the page title.
  • A three-dot button sits at the top right; tabs Pricing and Customers with the customer count sit under the title.
  • The matrix list has a checkbox column, Matrix, Work Order Matrix (with an info icon) and Part Sale Matrix.
  • Each matrix name is bold with its categories in muted text under it; a list longer than two categories ends with a blue "+1 more" link.
  • The General Matrix carries the blue Default badge; Part Sale values read "Same as work orders" in muted text, as in picture 2.32.

AUTOMATION: Not available on Build to test Yet - Last checked 11/14/2026
